description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for Orleans transaction tests using xUnit framework. It extends the base class to provide specific test cases related to transaction scope creation, nested transactions, and failure scenarios, parameterized with different grain states.

classes.name: ScopedTransactionsTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class extending ScopedTransactionsTestRunner, implementing test methods for transactional behavior in Orleans with xUnit. It provides parameterized tests for different grain state configurations.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValue
methods.description: Overrides base method to create a transaction scope and set value based on grainStates parameter.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueWithFailure
methods.description: Overrides base method to test transaction scope creation with induced failure for specific grainStates.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndAssert
methods.description: Overrides base method to create a transaction scope, set values, and perform assertions for given grainStates.

methods.name: CreateNestedTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndInnerFailAndAssert
methods.description: Overrides base method to test nested transaction scopes with inner failures and assertions.
